items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: All I can see is because of that French section down in town, plenty of them would call him Contrell, Cottrell from the accent... They called him Contrell, they called him Cantrell, some would call him Catrell.

ctx.x: And probably a lot of people knew maybe an Italian name, but have you had any explanation for the reason they call it that?

All I can see is because of that French section down in town, plenty of them would call him Contrell, Cottrell from the accent, but how it got started, I couldn't say. In your father's time, did they call him that too? They called him Contrell, they called him Cantrell, some would call him Catrell. Right through his face.
